-# PlayGround
+# ECHO — Ana, voice-only companion
 
-<!-- omgithub:readme:start -->
-## 🚀 Build, play, and remix with OMGithub
+A minimal Godot 4 portrait Android voice companion. There is no text-chat interface: a central animated orb, call status, and one End/Start Call button make up the call screen. The voice loop is online: OpenAI Whisper transcription → OpenAI chat completions → ElevenLabs speech synthesis.
 
-**Created using [OMGithub.com](https://go.ondev.store/).**
+## Clone, open, and export an Android APK
 
-[![OMGithub](https://img.shields.io/badge/OMGithub-Open%20project-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://go.ondev.store/Mark272291442/PlayGround)
-[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Source-181717?logo=github&style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround)
+Do the export on a computer with Godot installed; install and test the resulting APK on your Android phone.
 
-- 🎮 [Open the project](https://go.ondev.store/Mark272291442/PlayGround).
-- ✨ [Remix this project](https://go.ondev.store/Mark272291442/PlayGround?remix=1).
-- 💻 [Explore the source](https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround).
-- 🛠️ [Check build runs](https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround/actions).
-- 🐛 [Report an issue](https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround/issues).
-- 👤 [Explore the creator's projects](https://go.ondev.store/Mark272291442).
-- 🌍 [Create with OMGithub](https://go.ondev.store/).
-<!-- omgithub:readme:end -->
+1. Clone the repository and open it in Godot 4.3 or later:
+   ```sh
+   git clone https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround.git
+   cd PlayGround
+   ```
+   In Godot, choose **Import** and select this folder (the folder containing `project.godot`).
+2. In Godot, open **Editor > Manage Export Templates** and install the templates matching your Godot version.
+3. Install Android Studio and its Android SDK, plus OpenJDK 17. In Godot's **Editor > Editor Settings > Export > Android**, set the Java SDK Path and Android SDK Path to those installations.
+4. Open **Project > Export**, select the **Android** preset, and choose **Export Project**. Export a debug APK to `build/echo-android.apk` (create `build/` first if the file chooser requires it). The preset enables Internet and `RECORD_AUDIO` permissions.
+5. Install the APK on a connected Android device with USB debugging enabled:
+   ```sh
+   adb install -r build/echo-android.apk
+   ```
+6. Create `echo_config.cfg` on the computer using the example below. For this debug build, copy it into the app's private Godot `user://` directory with:
+   ```sh
+   adb shell run-as com.example.echo sh -c 'cat > files/echo_config.cfg' < echo_config.cfg
+   ```
+   This `run-as` method is for a debuggable APK; a release APK is not accessible this way. The package name is `com.example.echo` in the included export preset. Keep the config file and keys private. Relaunch ECHO and grant microphone access when prompted. If access was denied, enable it in Android Settings and tap **ALLOW MIC** to retry.
+
+For desktop runs, set `ECHO_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, and `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` in the environment. Godot's `user://` path is private app storage; credentials are deliberately not included in this repository.
+
+Example `user://echo_config.cfg`:
+
+```ini
+[api]
+stt_provider="openai"
+openai_api_key="YOUR_OPENAI_KEY"
+elevenlabs_api_key="YOUR_ELEVENLABS_KEY"
+elevenlabs_voice_id="YOUR_MULTILINGUAL_VOICE_ID"
+llm_model="gpt-4o-mini"
+stt_model="whisper-1"
+
+[companion]
+name="Ana"
+```
+
+Select a multilingual ElevenLabs voice that can speak Filipino/Tagalog. This project sends `language_code: fil` with `eleven_multilingual_v2`; voice availability and language behavior depend on your ElevenLabs account. OpenAI Whisper is selected instead of Soniox for the initial implementation because it works with a simple recorded-utterance HTTP request.
+
+## Included foundation
+
+- Portrait call UI with an animated orb that reacts to microphone capture and the AI voice output bus.
+- Microphone stream plus `AudioEffectRecord` PCM capture, voice-activity/silence detection, and a 12-second utterance cap.
+- OpenAI Whisper multipart WAV upload, short-context GPT chat requests, and ElevenLabs MP3 playback.
+- Barge-in detection: voice activity while Ana is speaking stops playback and starts a fresh recording.
+- Per-user config/environment loading; no real API keys are hardcoded.
+- Request timeouts, stale-request cancellation, readable warnings, and a local error chime/status phrase when the network fails.
+
+## Notes / production checklist
+
+- API secrets shipped in a mobile client can be extracted. The per-user config avoids committing keys, but a production public app should proxy provider requests through a backend with rate limits and user authentication.
+- The network-error phrase is presented in the status area and a local chime is played. A truly spoken offline recovery prompt requires bundling a licensed prerecorded audio asset; remote TTS cannot speak when the network itself is unavailable.
+- Mic VAD and speaker-to-mic echo vary by device. Tune thresholds in `scripts/Main.gd` and test with headphones plus the actual Android hardware.
+- No real API call can be tested without provider credentials and an Android microphone. The project is configured to run in the Godot editor and export as an Android app once credentials and export templates are installed.

+extends Control

+

+var _voice_bus := -1

+var _call_ended := false
+var _speech_seconds := 0.0
+var _silence_seconds := 0.0
+var _barge_seconds := 0.0

+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_build_ui()
+	_setup_audio()
+	_conversation.append({"role": "system", "content": _persona_prompt()})
+	if not OS.has_feature("mobile"):
+		print("ECHO: configure credentials in user://echo_config.cfg; see README.md")
+	var missing := EchoConfig.missing_setting()
+	if not missing.is_empty():
+		_end_button.text = "SETUP NEEDED"
+		_end_button.disabled = true
+		_set_state("setup", "Add API credentials to start")
+		_hint.text = "See README for private setup"
+	else:
+		_mic_permission_granted = _start_mic()
+		if _mic_permission_granted:
+			_set_state("listening", "Say hello to Ana")
+		else:
+			_show_mic_permission_error()
+
+func _persona_prompt() -> String:
+	return EchoConfig.SYSTEM_PROMPT.replace("You are Ana", "You are %s" % EchoConfig.ana_name)
+
+func _build_ui() -> void:
+	set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	var background := ColorRect.new()

+	top_glow.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_WIDE)
+	add_child(top_glow)
+
+	var brand := Label.new()

+	brand.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	brand.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
+	brand.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("9aa8c3"))
+	brand.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_WIDE)
+	brand.offset_top = 54
+	brand.offset_bottom = 82
+	add_child(brand)
+
+	var companion := Label.new()
+	companion.text = EchoConfig.ana_name
+	companion.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+	companion.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 35)
+	companion.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("f4f6ff"))
+	companion.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_WIDE)
+	companion.offset_top = 117
+	companion.offset_bottom = 165
+	add_child(companion)
+

+	_status.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)

+	_status.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_TOP_WIDE)

191: 	var level_db := linear_to_db(maxf(mic_amplitude, 0.00001))
192: 	var voice_db := AudioServer.get_bus_peak_volume_left_db(_voice_bus, 0) if _voice_bus >= 0 else -80.0
193: 	_orb.call("set_levels", clampf((level_db + 55.0) / 45.0, 0.0, 1.0), clampf((voice_db + 55.0) / 45.0, 0.0, 1.0))

202: 	if _state != "listening" and _state != "capturing":

206: 			_begin_capture()

216: func _read_mic_amplitude() -> float:
217: 	if _mic_capture == null:

222: 	var frames := _mic_capture.get_buffer(mini(available, 4096))
223: 	var sum_squared := 0.0
224: 	for frame in frames:
225: 		sum_squared += frame.length_squared()
226: 	return sqrt(sum_squared / maxf(float(frames.size()), 1.0))

253: func _transcribe_openai(audio: PackedByteArray) -> void:
254: 	var boundary := "EchoBoundary" + str(Time.get_ticks_usec())
255: 	var body := PackedByteArray()
256: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"model\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, EchoConfig.stt_model])
257: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"language\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, "tl"])

259: 	body.append_array(audio)
260: 	_append_text(body, "\r\n--%s--\r\n" % boundary)
261: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary])
262: 	_send_request(WHISPER_URL, headers, body, "stt_openai")

264: func _send_to_llm(transcript: String) -> void:
265: 	if transcript.strip_edges().is_empty():

269: 	# Keep a short rolling context to avoid excessive cost and latency.
270: 	if _conversation.size() > 11:

272: 	var payload := {"model": EchoConfig.llm_model, "messages": _conversation, "temperature": 0.8, "max_tokens": 120}
273: 	var body := JSON.stringify(payload).to_utf8_buffer()
274: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: application/json"])
275: 	_set_state("thinking", "Thinking of what to say…")
276: 	_send_request(CHAT_URL, headers, body, "llm")

290: func _send_request(url: String, headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String) -> void:
291: 	_generation += 1
292: 	var token := _generation
293: 	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
294: 	http.timeout = 35.0
295: 	http.body_size_limit = 16 * 1024 * 1024
296: 	add_child(http)
297: 	http.request_completed.connect(_on_request_completed.bind(purpose, token, http))
298: 	var err := http.request_raw(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, body)
299: 	if err != OK:
300: 		http.queue_free()
301: 		_handle_network_error("Could not start network request")
302: 
303: func _on_request_completed(result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String, token: int, http: HTTPRequest) -> void:
304: 	http.queue_free()
305: 	if token != _generation or _call_ended:
306: 		return
307: 	if result != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS or response_code < 200 or response_code >= 300:
308: 		var details := body.get_string_from_utf8()
309: 		if details.length() > 240:
310: 			details = details.left(240)
311: 		push_warning("ECHO %s request failed (%s): %s" % [purpose, response_code, details])
312: 		_handle_network_error("Network hiccup")
313: 		return
314: 	match purpose:
315: 		"stt_openai":
316: 			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
317: 			_send_to_llm(str(parsed.get("text", "")))
318: 		"llm":
319: 			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
320: 			var choices: Array = parsed.get("choices", [])
321: 			if choices.is_empty():
322: 				_handle_network_error("Ana couldn’t respond")
323: 				return
324: 			var reply := str(choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "")).strip_edges()
325: 			if reply.is_empty():
326: 				_handle_network_error("Ana couldn’t respond")
327: 				return
328: 			_conversation.append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply})
329: 			_request_tts(reply)
330: 		"tts":
331: 			_play_tts(body)

366: 	_player.stop()
367: 	_state = "listening"

374: func _play_error_chime() -> void:
375: 	# A short local signal still works when the network is unavailable. The spoken
376: 	# recovery phrase is shown in the call status; cache an OGG for spoken fallback
377: 	# if an offline spoken prompt is required by your deployment.
378: 	var sample_rate := 22050
379: 	var samples := PackedByteArray()
380: 	for i in range(int(sample_rate * 0.18)):
381: 		var envelope := 1.0 - float(i) / float(sample_rate * 0.18)
382: 		var sample := int(sin(TAU * 520.0 * float(i) / sample_rate) * 7000.0 * envelope)
383: 		samples.append(sample & 0xff)
384: 		samples.append((sample >> 8) & 0xff)
385: 	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
386: 	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
387: 	wav.mix_rate = sample_rate
388: 	wav.stereo = false
389: 	wav.data = samples
390: 	_error_tone.stream = wav
391: 	_error_tone.play()

393: func _wav_bytes(source: AudioStreamWAV) -> PackedByteArray:
394: 	var pcm := source.data
395: 	var channels := 2 if source.stereo else 1
396: 	var rate := source.mix_rate
397: 	var bytes_per_sample := 2 if source.format == AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS else 1
398: 	var wav := PackedByteArray()
399: 	_append_text(wav, "RIFF")
400: 	_append_u32(wav, 36 + pcm.size())
401: 	_append_text(wav, "WAVEfmt ")
402: 	_append_u32(wav, 16)
403: 	_append_u16(wav, 1)
404: 	_append_u16(wav, channels)
405: 	_append_u32(wav, rate)
406: 	_append_u32(wav, rate * channels * bytes_per_sample)
407: 	_append_u16(wav, channels * bytes_per_sample)
408: 	_append_u16(wav, bytes_per_sample * 8)
409: 	_append_text(wav, "data")
410: 	_append_u32(wav, pcm.size())
411: 	wav.append_array(pcm)
412: 	return wav
413: 
414: func _append_text(target: PackedByteArray, text: String) -> void:
415: 	target.append_array(text.to_utf8_buffer())
416: 
417: func _append_u16(target: PackedByteArray, value: int) -> void:
418: 	target.append(value & 0xff)
419: 	target.append((value >> 8) & 0xff)
420: 
421: func _append_u32(target: PackedByteArray, value: int) -> void:
422: 	for shift in [0, 8, 16, 24]:
423: 		target.append((value >> shift) & 0xff)
424:

431: 		_orb.call("set_mode", mode)
432: 	if next_state == "listening":
433: 		_hint.text = "Your call is private to you"

1: # ECHO — Ana, voice-only companion
2: 
3: A minimal Godot 4 portrait Android voice companion. There is no text-chat interface: a central animated orb, call status, and one End/Start Call button make up the call screen. The voice loop is online: OpenAI Whisper transcription → OpenAI chat completions → ElevenLabs speech synthesis.
4: 
5: ## Clone, open, and export an Android APK
6: 
7: Do the export on a computer with Godot installed; install and test the resulting APK on your Android phone.
8: 
9: 1. Clone the repository and open it in Godot 4.3 or later:
10:    ```sh
11:    git clone https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround.git
12:    cd PlayGround
13:    ```
14:    In Godot, choose **Import** and select this folder (the folder containing `project.godot`).
15: 2. In Godot, open **Editor > Manage Export Templates** and install the templates matching your Godot version.
16: 3. Install Android Studio and its Android SDK, plus OpenJDK 17. In Godot's **Editor > Editor Settings > Export > Android**, set the Java SDK Path and Android SDK Path to those installations.
17: 4. Open **Project > Export**, select the **Android** preset, and choose **Export Project**. Export a debug APK to `build/echo-android.apk` (create `build/` first if the file chooser requires it). The preset enables Internet and `RECORD_AUDIO` permissions.
18: 5. Install the APK on a connected Android device with USB debugging enabled:
19:    ```sh
20:    adb install -r build/echo-android.apk
21:    ```
22: 6. Create `echo_config.cfg` on the computer using the example below. For this debug build, copy it into the app's private Godot `user://` directory with:
23:    ```sh
24:    adb shell run-as com.example.echo sh -c 'cat > files/echo_config.cfg' < echo_config.cfg
25:    ```
26:    This `run-as` method is for a debuggable APK; a release APK is not accessible this way. The package name is `com.example.echo` in the included export preset. Keep the config file and keys private. Relaunch ECHO and grant microphone access when prompted. If access was denied, enable it in Android Settings and tap **ALLOW MIC** to retry.
27: 
28: For desktop runs, set `ECHO_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, and `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` in the environment. Godot's `user://` path is private app storage; credentials are deliberately not included in this repository.
29: 
30: Example `user://echo_config.cfg`:
31: 
32: ```ini
33: [api]
34: stt_provider="openai"
35: openai_api_key="YOUR_OPENAI_KEY"
36: elevenlabs_api_key="YOUR_ELEVENLABS_KEY"
37: elevenlabs_voice_id="YOUR_MULTILINGUAL_VOICE_ID"
38: llm_model="gpt-4o-mini"
39: stt_model="whisper-1"
40: 
41: [companion]
42: name="Ana"
43: ```
44: 
45: Select a multilingual ElevenLabs voice that can speak Filipino/Tagalog. This project sends `language_code: fil` with `eleven_multilingual_v2`; voice availability and language behavior depend on your ElevenLabs account. OpenAI Whisper is selected instead of Soniox for the initial implementation because it works with a simple recorded-utterance HTTP request.
46: 
47: ## Included foundation
48: 
49: - Portrait call UI with an animated orb that reacts to microphone capture and the AI voice output bus.
50: - Microphone stream plus `AudioEffectRecord` PCM capture, voice-activity/silence detection, and a 12-second utterance cap.
51: - OpenAI Whisper multipart WAV upload, short-context GPT chat requests, and ElevenLabs MP3 playback.
52: - Barge-in detection: voice activity while Ana is speaking stops playback and starts a fresh recording.
53: - Per-user config/environment loading; no real API keys are hardcoded.
54: - Request timeouts, stale-request cancellation, readable warnings, and a local error chime/status phrase when the network fails.
55: 
56: ## Notes / production checklist
57: 
58: - API secrets shipped in a mobile client can be extracted. The per-user config avoids committing keys, but a production public app should proxy provider requests through a backend with rate limits and user authentication.
59: - The network-error phrase is presented in the status area and a local chime is played. A truly spoken offline recovery prompt requires bundling a licensed prerecorded audio asset; remote TTS cannot speak when the network itself is unavailable.
60: - Mic VAD and speaker-to-mic echo vary by device. Tune thresholds in `scripts/Main.gd` and test with headphones plus the actual Android hardware.
61: - No real API call can be tested without provider credentials and an Android microphone. The project is configured to run in the Godot editor and export as an Android app once credentials and export templates are installed.

253: func _transcribe_openai(audio: PackedByteArray) -> void:
254: 	var boundary := "EchoBoundary" + str(Time.get_ticks_usec())
255: 	var body := PackedByteArray()
256: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"model\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, EchoConfig.stt_model])
257: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"language\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, "tl"])
258: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"utterance.wav\"\r\nContent-Type: audio/wav\r\n\r\n" % boundary)
259: 	body.append_array(audio)
260: 	_append_text(body, "\r\n--%s--\r\n" % boundary)
261: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary])
262: 	_send_request(WHISPER_URL, headers, body, "stt_openai")

264: func _send_to_llm(transcript: String) -> void:
265: 	if transcript.strip_edges().is_empty():
266: 		_set_state("listening", "I didn’t catch that. Try again")
267: 		return
268: 	_conversation.append({"role": "user", "content": transcript})
269: 	# Keep a short rolling context to avoid excessive cost and latency.
270: 	if _conversation.size() > 11:
271: 		_conversation = [_conversation[0]] + _conversation.slice(_conversation.size() - 9)
272: 	var payload := {"model": EchoConfig.llm_model, "messages": _conversation, "temperature": 0.8, "max_tokens": 120}
273: 	var body := JSON.stringify(payload).to_utf8_buffer()
274: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: application/json"])
275: 	_set_state("thinking", "Thinking of what to say…")
276: 	_send_request(CHAT_URL, headers, body, "llm")

278: func _request_tts(text: String) -> void:
279: 	var url := "https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/%s?output_format=mp3_44100_128" % EchoConfig.elevenlabs_voice_id.uri_encode()
280: 	var payload := {
281: 		"text": text,
282: 		"model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2",
283: 		"language_code": "fil",
284: 		"voice_settings": {"stability": 0.38, "similarity_boost": 0.78, "style": 0.55, "use_speaker_boost": true}
285: 	}
286: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["xi-api-key: " + EchoConfig.elevenlabs_api_key, "Content-Type: application/json", "Accept: audio/mpeg"])
287: 	_set_state("synthesizing", "Let me say that…")
288: 	_send_request(url, headers, JSON.stringify(payload).to_utf8_buffer(), "tts")
289: 
290: func _send_request(url: String, headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String) -> void:
291: 	_generation += 1
292: 	var token := _generation
293: 	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
294: 	http.timeout = 35.0
295: 	http.body_size_limit = 16 * 1024 * 1024
296: 	add_child(http)
297: 	http.request_completed.connect(_on_request_completed.bind(purpose, token, http))
298: 	var err := http.request_raw(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, body)
299: 	if err != OK:
300: 		http.queue_free()
301: 		_handle_network_error("Could not start network request")
302: 
303: func _on_request_completed(result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String, token: int, http: HTTPRequest) -> void:
304: 	http.queue_free()
305: 	if token != _generation or _call_ended:
306: 		return
307: 	if result != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS or response_code < 200 or response_code >= 300:
308: 		var details := body.get_string_from_utf8()
309: 		if details.length() > 240:
310: 			details = details.left(240)
311: 		push_warning("ECHO %s request failed (%s): %s" % [purpose, response_code, details])
312: 		_handle_network_error("Network hiccup")
313: 		return
314: 	match purpose:
315: 		"stt_openai":
316: 			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
317: 			_send_to_llm(str(parsed.get("text", "")))
318: 		"llm":
319: 			var parsed := _parse_json(body)
320: 			var choices: Array = parsed.get("choices", [])
321: 			if choices.is_empty():
322: 				_handle_network_error("Ana couldn’t respond")
323: 				return
324: 			var reply := str(choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "")).strip_edges()
325: 			if reply.is_empty():
326: 				_handle_network_error("Ana couldn’t respond")
327: 				return
328: 			_conversation.append({"role": "assistant", "content": reply})
329: 			_request_tts(reply)
330: 		"tts":

1: # ECHO — Ana, voice-only companion
2: 
3: A minimal Godot 4 portrait Android voice companion. There is no text-chat interface: a central animated orb, call status, and one End/Start Call button make up the call screen. The voice loop is online: OpenAI Whisper transcription → OpenAI chat completions → ElevenLabs speech synthesis.
4: 
5: ## Clone, open, and export an Android APK
6: 
7: Do the export on a computer with Godot installed; install and test the resulting APK on your Android phone.
8: 
9: 1. Clone the repository and open it in Godot 4.3 or later:
10:    ```sh
11:    git clone https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround.git
12:    cd PlayGround
13:    ```
14:    In Godot, choose **Import** and select this folder (the folder containing `project.godot`).
15: 2. In Godot, open **Editor > Manage Export Templates** and install the templates matching your Godot version.
16: 3. Install Android Studio and its Android SDK, plus OpenJDK 17. In Godot's **Editor > Editor Settings > Export > Android**, set the Java SDK Path and Android SDK Path to those installations.
17: 4. Open **Project > Export**, select the **Android** preset, and choose **Export Project**. Export a debug APK to `build/echo-android.apk` (create `build/` first if the file chooser requires it). The preset enables Internet and `RECORD_AUDIO` permissions.
18: 5. Install the APK on a connected Android device with USB debugging enabled:
19:    ```sh
20:    adb install -r build/echo-android.apk
21:    ```
22: 6. Create `echo_config.cfg` on the computer using the example below. For this debug build, copy it into the app's private Godot `user://` directory with:
23:    ```sh
24:    adb shell run-as com.example.echo sh -c 'cat > files/echo_config.cfg' < echo_config.cfg
25:    ```
26:    This `run-as` method is for a debuggable APK; a release APK is not accessible this way. The package name is `com.example.echo` in the included export preset. Keep the config file and keys private. Relaunch ECHO and grant microphone access when prompted. If access was denied, enable it in Android Settings and tap **ALLOW MIC** to retry.
27: 
28: For desktop runs, set `ECHO_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, and `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` in the environment. Godot's `user://` path is private app storage; credentials are deliberately not included in this repository.
29: 
30: Example `user://echo_config.cfg`:
31: 
32: ```ini
33: [api]
34: stt_provider="openai"
35: openai_api_key="YOUR_OPENAI_KEY"
36: elevenlabs_api_key="YOUR_ELEVENLABS_KEY"
37: elevenlabs_voice_id="YOUR_MULTILINGUAL_VOICE_ID"
38: llm_model="gpt-4o-mini"
39: stt_model="whisper-1"
40: 
41: [companion]
42: name="Ana"
43: ```
44: 
45: Select a multilingual ElevenLabs voice that can speak Filipino/Tagalog. This project sends `language_code: fil` with `eleven_multilingual_v2`; voice availability and language behavior depend on your ElevenLabs account. OpenAI Whisper is selected instead of Soniox for the initial implementation because it works with a simple recorded-utterance HTTP request.
46: 
47: ## Included foundation
48: 
49: - Portrait call UI with an animated orb that reacts to microphone capture and the AI voice output bus.
50: - Microphone stream plus `AudioEffectRecord` PCM capture, voice-activity/silence detection, and a 12-second utterance cap.
51: - OpenAI Whisper multipart WAV upload, short-context GPT chat requests, and ElevenLabs MP3 playback.
52: - Barge-in detection: voice activity while Ana is speaking stops playback and starts a fresh recording.
53: - Per-user config/environment loading; no real API keys are hardcoded.
54: - Request timeouts, stale-request cancellation, readable warnings, and a local error chime/status phrase when the network fails.
55: 
56: ## Notes / production checklist
57: 
58: - API secrets shipped in a mobile client can be extracted. The per-user config avoids committing keys, but a production public app should proxy provider requests through a backend with rate limits and user authentication.
59: - The network-error phrase is presented in the status area and a local chime is played. A truly spoken offline recovery prompt requires bundling a licensed prerecorded audio asset; remote TTS cannot speak when the network itself is unavailable.
60: - Mic VAD and speaker-to-mic echo vary by device. Tune thresholds in `scripts/Main.gd` and test with headphones plus the actual Android hardware.
61: - No real API call can be tested without provider credentials and an Android microphone. The project is configured to run in the Godot editor and export as an Android app once credentials and export templates are installed.

## Objective
- Fix ECHO’s Android layout and visuals so the exported app matches the web Preview, then push the fixes to `opencode/41871913075`.

## Requirements
- Set the base resolution to `1080x1920`, stretch mode to `canvas_items`, and aspect to `expand`.
- Keep the renderer compatible with Android; correctly link the UI theme, fonts, and button styles in `Main.tscn`.
- Push the fixes to the existing branch. Keep API credentials out of the repository.

## Decisions
- The project already uses `gl_compatibility` for both renderer settings.
- The web Preview in `dist/index.html` is the visual reference.
- Added bundled Lato fonts as a custom font option; include their license with the assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- The earlier ECHO implementation was committed as `e12dbfc` and pushed to `origin/opencode/41871913075`.
- The Android export preset already enables Internet and microphone permissions.
- Added initial uncommitted assets: `assets/ECHOTheme.tres`, `assets/shaders/orb.gdshader`, and bundled Lato font files.

### Active
- Update `project.godot` display settings and link the theme in `Main.tscn`.
- Integrate the shader into `scripts/Orb.gd` and align the native UI layout and button styling with the Preview.
- Add the font license, validate the resource references, then commit and push the fixes.

### Blocked
- Godot is not available in the environment, so project parsing/export and Android device validation remain untested.

## Next Move
1. Finish wiring the new theme, fonts, and orb shader; set the requested display settings.
2. Check resource syntax and the working tree; avoid including unrelated untracked helper/preview files.
3. Commit and push the intended changes to `opencode/41871913075`.

## Relevant Files
- `project.godot`: current resolution and renderer settings.
- `Main.tscn`: scene root where the theme must be linked.
- `scripts/Main.gd`: dynamically built UI layout and button behavior.
- `scripts/Orb.gd`: current orb drawing and animation logic.
- `assets/ECHOTheme.tres`: newly created theme; verify resource syntax and load-step count.
- `assets/shaders/orb.gdshader`: newly created orb shader, not yet integrated.
- `dist/index.html`: web Preview reference; untracked.
- `export_presets.cfg`: Android export settings and permissions.
- `README.md`: clone/setup/export and credential instructions.

## Important Context
- Current branch is `opencode/41871913075`, tracking `origin/opencode/41871913075`; latest pushed commit is `e12dbfc`.
- Earlier unrelated untracked files remain: `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `dist/`, `scripts/build-preview.mjs`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`; do not accidentally commit them.
- No changes for the new visual-fix request have been committed or pushed yet.

253: func _transcribe_openai(audio: PackedByteArray) -> void:
254: 	var boundary := "EchoBoundary" + str(Time.get_ticks_usec())
255: 	var body := PackedByteArray()
256: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"model\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, EchoConfig.stt_model])
257: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"language\"\r\n\r\n%s\r\n" % [boundary, "tl"])
258: 	_append_text(body, "--%s\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"file\"; filename=\"utterance.wav\"\r\nContent-Type: audio/wav\r\n\r\n" % boundary)
259: 	body.append_array(audio)
260: 	_append_text(body, "\r\n--%s--\r\n" % boundary)
261: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=" + boundary])
262: 	_send_request(WHISPER_URL, headers, body, "stt_openai")

264: func _send_to_llm(transcript: String) -> void:
265: 	if transcript.strip_edges().is_empty():
266: 		_set_state("listening", "I didn’t catch that. Try again")
267: 		return
268: 	_conversation.append({"role": "user", "content": transcript})
269: 	# Keep a short rolling context to avoid excessive cost and latency.
270: 	if _conversation.size() > 11:
271: 		_conversation = [_conversation[0]] + _conversation.slice(_conversation.size() - 9)
272: 	var payload := {"model": EchoConfig.llm_model, "messages": _conversation, "temperature": 0.8, "max_tokens": 120}
273: 	var body := JSON.stringify(payload).to_utf8_buffer()
274: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["Authorization: Bearer " + EchoConfig.openai_api_key, "Content-Type: application/json"])
275: 	_set_state("thinking", "Thinking of what to say…")
276: 	_send_request(CHAT_URL, headers, body, "llm")

278: func _request_tts(text: String) -> void:

281: 		"text": text,
282: 		"model_id": "eleven_multilingual_v2",
283: 		"language_code": "fil",
284: 		"voice_settings": {"stability": 0.38, "similarity_boost": 0.78, "style": 0.55, "use_speaker_boost": true}
285: 	}
286: 	var headers := PackedStringArray(["xi-api-key: " + EchoConfig.elevenlabs_api_key, "Content-Type: application/json", "Accept: audio/mpeg"])
287: 	_set_state("synthesizing", "Let me say that…")
288: 	_send_request(url, headers, JSON.stringify(payload).to_utf8_buffer(), "tts")

290: func _send_request(url: String, headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String) -> void:
291: 	_generation += 1
292: 	var token := _generation
293: 	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
294: 	http.timeout = 35.0
295: 	http.body_size_limit = 16 * 1024 * 1024
296: 	add_child(http)
297: 	http.request_completed.connect(_on_request_completed.bind(purpose, token, http))
298: 	var err := http.request_raw(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, body)
299: 	if err != OK:
300: 		http.queue_free()
301: 		_handle_network_error("Could not start network request")
302: 
303: func _on_request_completed(result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray, purpose: String, token: int, http: HTTPRequest) -> void:
304: 	http.queue_free()
305: 	if token != _generation or _call_ended:
306: 		return
307: 	if result != HTTPRequest.RESULT_SUCCESS or response_code < 200 or response_code >= 300:
308: 		var details := body.get_string_from_utf8()
309: 		if details.length() > 240:
310: 			details = details.left(240)
311: 		push_warning("ECHO %s request failed (%s): %s" % [purpose, response_code, details])
312: 		_handle_network_error("Network hiccup")
313: 		return
314: 	match purpose:
315: 		"stt_openai":
316: 			var parsed := _parse_json(body)

338: 	var stream := AudioStreamMP3.new()
339: 	stream.data = data
340: 	_player.stream = stream
341: 	_state = "speaking"
342: 	_barge_seconds = 0.0
343: 	_orb.call("set_mode", "speaking")
344: 	_set_state("speaking", "Ana is speaking")
345: 	_player.play()

348: 	if _state == "speaking" and not _call_ended:
349: 		_set_state("listening", "I’m here")

351: func _barge_in() -> void:
352: 	_generation += 1 # Ignore any stale network response if barge-in raced a request.
353: 	_player.stop()
354: 	_recorder.set_recording_active(false)
355: 	_recorder.set_recording_active(true)
356: 	_state = "capturing"
357: 	_speech_seconds = 0.0

359: 	_barge_seconds = 0.0

363: func _handle_network_error(message: String) -> void:
364: 	if _call_ended:
365: 		return
366: 	_player.stop()
367: 	_state = "listening"

374: func _play_error_chime() -> void:
375: 	# A short local signal still works when the network is unavailable. The spoken
376: 	# recovery phrase is shown in the call status; cache an OGG for spoken fallback
377: 	# if an offline spoken prompt is required by your deployment.
378: 	var sample_rate := 22050
379: 	var samples := PackedByteArray()
380: 	for i in range(int(sample_rate * 0.18)):
381: 		var envelope := 1.0 - float(i) / float(sample_rate * 0.18)
382: 		var sample := int(sin(TAU * 520.0 * float(i) / sample_rate) * 7000.0 * envelope)
383: 		samples.append(sample & 0xff)
384: 		samples.append((sample >> 8) & 0xff)
385: 	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
386: 	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
387: 	wav.mix_rate = sample_rate
388: 	wav.stereo = false
389: 	wav.data = samples
390: 	_error_tone.stream = wav

393: func _wav_bytes(source: AudioStreamWAV) -> PackedByteArray:
394: 	var pcm := source.data
395: 	var channels := 2 if source.stereo else 1
396: 	var rate := source.mix_rate
397: 	var bytes_per_sample := 2 if source.format == AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS else 1
398: 	var wav := PackedByteArray()
399: 	_append_text(wav, "RIFF")
400: 	_append_u32(wav, 36 + pcm.size())
401: 	_append_text(wav, "WAVEfmt ")
402: 	_append_u32(wav, 16)
403: 	_append_u16(wav, 1)
404: 	_append_u16(wav, channels)
405: 	_append_u32(wav, rate)
406: 	_append_u32(wav, rate * channels * bytes_per_sample)
407: 	_append_u16(wav, channels * bytes_per_sample)
408: 	_append_u16(wav, bytes_per_sample * 8)
409: 	_append_text(wav, "data")
410: 	_append_u32(wav, pcm.size())
411: 	wav.append_array(pcm)
412: 	return wav

414: func _append_text(target: PackedByteArray, text: String) -> void:
415: 	target.append_array(text.to_utf8_buffer())
416: 
417: func _append_u16(target: PackedByteArray, value: int) -> void:
418: 	target.append(value & 0xff)
419: 	target.append((value >> 8) & 0xff)
420: 
421: func _append_u32(target: PackedByteArray, value: int) -> void:
422: 	for shift in [0, 8, 16, 24]:
423: 		target.append((value >> shift) & 0xff)

426: 	_state = next_state
427: 	if is_instance_valid(_status):
428: 		_status.text = message
429: 	if is_instance_valid(_orb):
430: 		var mode := "speaking" if next_state == "speaking" else ("listening" if next_state in ["listening", "capturing"] else "thinking")
431: 		_orb.call("set_mode", mode)
432: 	if next_state == "listening":
433: 		_hint.text = "Your call is private to you"
434:

436: 	if _call_ended or not _mic_permission_granted:
437: 		if not _start_mic():
438: 			_show_mic_permission_error()
439: 			return
440: 		_mic_permission_granted = true
441: 		_call_ended = false
442: 		_generation += 1

444: 		_hint.text = "Your call is private to you"
445: 		_set_state("listening", "Say hello to Ana")
446: 		return
447: 	_call_ended = true

1: # ECHO — Ana, voice-only companion
2: 
3: A minimal Godot 4 portrait Android voice companion. There is no text-chat interface: a central animated orb, call status, and one End/Start Call button make up the call screen. The voice loop is online: OpenAI Whisper transcription → OpenAI chat completions → ElevenLabs speech synthesis.
4: 
5: ## Clone, open, and export an Android APK
6: 
7: Do the export on a computer with Godot installed; install and test the resulting APK on your Android phone.
8: 
9: 1. Clone the repository and open it in Godot 4.3 or later:
10:    ```sh
11:    git clone https://github.com/Mark272291442/PlayGround.git
12:    cd PlayGround
13:    ```
14:    In Godot, choose **Import** and select this folder (the folder containing `project.godot`).
15: 2. In Godot, open **Editor > Manage Export Templates** and install the templates matching your Godot version.
16: 3. Install Android Studio and its Android SDK, plus OpenJDK 17. In Godot's **Editor > Editor Settings > Export > Android**, set the Java SDK Path and Android SDK Path to those installations.
17: 4. Open **Project > Export**, select the **Android** preset, and choose **Export Project**. Export a debug APK to `build/echo-android.apk` (create `build/` first if the file chooser requires it). The preset enables Internet and `RECORD_AUDIO` permissions.
18: 5. Install the APK on a connected Android device with USB debugging enabled:
19:    ```sh
20:    adb install -r build/echo-android.apk
21:    ```
22: 6. Create `echo_config.cfg` on the computer using the example below. For this debug build, copy it into the app's private Godot `user://` directory with:
23:    ```sh
24:    adb shell run-as com.example.echo sh -c 'cat > files/echo_config.cfg' < echo_config.cfg
25:    ```
26:    This `run-as` method is for a debuggable APK; a release APK is not accessible this way. The package name is `com.example.echo` in the included export preset. Keep the config file and keys private. Relaunch ECHO and grant microphone access when prompted. If access was denied, enable it in Android Settings and tap **ALLOW MIC** to retry.
27: 
28: For desktop runs, set `ECHO_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_API_KEY`, and `ECHO_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID` in the environment. Godot's `user://` path is private app storage; credentials are deliberately not included in this repository.
29: 
30: Example `user://echo_config.cfg`:
31: 
32: ```ini
33: [api]
34: stt_provider="openai"
35: openai_api_key="YOUR_OPENAI_KEY"
36: elevenlabs_api_key="YOUR_ELEVENLABS_KEY"
37: elevenlabs_voice_id="YOUR_MULTILINGUAL_VOICE_ID"
38: llm_model="gpt-4o-mini"
39: stt_model="whisper-1"
40: 
41: [companion]
42: name="Ana"
43: ```
44: 
45: Select a multilingual ElevenLabs voice that can speak Filipino/Tagalog. This project sends `language_code: fil` with `eleven_multilingual_v2`; voice availability and language behavior depend on your ElevenLabs account. OpenAI Whisper is selected instead of Soniox for the initial implementation because it works with a simple recorded-utterance HTTP request.
46: 
47: ## Included foundation
48: 
49: - Portrait call UI with an animated orb that reacts to microphone capture and the AI voice output bus.
50: - Microphone stream plus `AudioEffectRecord` PCM capture, voice-activity/silence detection, and a 12-second utterance cap.
51: - OpenAI Whisper multipart WAV upload, short-context GPT chat requests, and ElevenLabs MP3 playback.
52: - Barge-in detection: voice activity while Ana is speaking stops playback and starts a fresh recording.
53: - Per-user config/environment loading; no real API keys are hardcoded.
54: - Request timeouts, stale-request cancellation, readable warnings, and a local error chime/status phrase when the network fails.
55: 
56: ## Notes / production checklist
57: 
58: - API secrets shipped in a mobile client can be extracted. The per-user config avoids committing keys, but a production public app should proxy provider requests through a backend with rate limits and user authentication.
59: - The network-error phrase is presented in the status area and a local chime is played. A truly spoken offline recovery prompt requires bundling a licensed prerecorded audio asset; remote TTS cannot speak when the network itself is unavailable.
60: - Mic VAD and speaker-to-mic echo vary by device. Tune thresholds in `scripts/Main.gd` and test with headphones plus the actual Android hardware.
61: - No real API call can be tested without provider credentials and an Android microphone. The project is configured to run in the Godot editor and export as an Android app once credentials and export templates are installed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Fix ECHO’s Android layout and visuals to match the web Preview, then commit and push the changes to `opencode/41871913075`.

## Requirements
- Set the base resolution to `1080x1920`, stretch mode to `canvas_items`, and aspect to `expand`.
- Keep the renderer Android-compatible; correctly link the UI theme, fonts, and button styling.
- Keep API credentials out of the repository.

## Decisions
- Use `dist/index.html` as the visual reference.
- Keep `gl_compatibility` for both renderer settings.
- Bundle Lato fonts and include their license.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `project.godot` to the requested base resolution, `canvas_items` stretch, and `expand` aspect.
- Linked `assets/ECHOTheme.tres` from `Main.tscn`.
- Reworked `scripts/Main.gd` layout and styling to align with the Preview.
- Replaced the orb’s drawn shapes with the shader in `assets/shaders/orb.gdshader`; added a radial background shader.

### Active
- Add the Lato license and review resource syntax/references.
- Check the intended changes, then commit and push them to `opencode/41871913075`.

### Blocked
- Godot is unavailable, so project parsing, export, and Android device validation cannot be run here.

## Next Move
1. Add the Lato OFL license under `assets/fonts/`.
2. Inspect the resource files and Git status; exclude unrelated untracked helper and preview files.
3. Validate what can be checked without Godot, then commit and push the intended changes.

## Relevant Files
- `project.godot`: requested display settings and renderer configuration.
- `Main.tscn`: root scene and linked theme.
- `scripts/Main.gd`: dynamically built UI layout and button behavior.
- `scripts/Orb.gd`: orb drawing and animation using the shader.
- `assets/ECHOTheme.tres`: UI theme and font/style resources.
- `assets/shaders/orb.gdshader`: orb appearance.
- `assets/shaders/background.gdshader`: radial background.
- `assets/fonts/`: bundled Lato font files; license still needed.
- `dist/index.html`: visual reference; untracked and not intended for commit.
- `export_presets.cfg`: Android export settings and permissions.
- `README.md`: setup and credential guidance.

## Important Context
- Branch `opencode/41871913075` tracks `origin/opencode/41871913075`; latest pushed commit is `e12dbfc`.
- Changes are uncommitted. Earlier unrelated untracked files include `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `dist/`, `scripts/build-preview.mjs`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`; do not include them.
- Android export preset enables Internet and microphone permissions.
- API credentials must remain outside the repository.
